facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts
Full-screen sponsored recommendation of a new release shown to Free and Premium listeners on app open/Home
Targets listeners based on their listening history rather than broad demographics or interests
Filters out listeners who already intentionally streamed the release (automatic suppression of already-converted listeners)
New-release only; start date within the first 3 weeks of release, bookable up to 18 days post-release
CPC pricing, $100 minimum per (sub-)campaign; typical CPC $0.55-$1.50 (Chartlex 2026 campaign data; older reports ~$0.50); 10-day window; pay only for clicks; unspent budget not charged
Reporting: listens, saves, playlist adds from exposed listeners; Spotify claims exposed listeners are >2x more likely to save/add and 3x more likely to stream the artist's other releases
Halo effect: Marquee clicks produce saves, playlist adds, follows, and catalog streams - all inputs to Spotify's organic recommendation systems (Discover Weekly, Release Radar, Radio)
